name: Folk
label: Folk External API REST v1 — people, companies, notes
description: Official Folk External API REST v1 at https://api.folk.app (OpenAPI 2025-06-09). NOT GraphQL. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer workspace apiKey. Pin X-API-Version from config apiVersion (default 2025-06-09). People/companies/notes are PII. Customer owns the Folk workspace. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event). apiKey is never logged or returned.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Folk REST v1. Do not put apiKey here. Example: {"operation":"person.get","personId":"per_…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'person.create' | 'person.get' | 'person.update' | 'person.search' | 'company.create' | 'company.get' | 'company.update' | 'group.list' | 'note.create' | 'customField.set' | 'trigger.listen'. trigger.listen never opens a socket.

schema.label: personId
schema.description: Folk person id (per_…) for person.get / person.update. Example: per_01HZX.

schema.label: companyId
schema.description: Folk company id (com_…) for company.get / company.update.

schema.label: entityCollection
schema.description: customField.set path collection. EXACT: 'people' or 'companies'.

schema.label: entityId
schema.description: Target entity id: the person/company/object the note is linked to on note.create (sent as entity.id), or the record patched by customField.set. Example: per_55175e81-9a52-4ac3-930e-82792c23499b.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: Given name for person.create / person.update. Max 500.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Family name for person.create / person.update. Max 500.

schema.label: fullName
schema.description: Combined name. Max 1000.

schema.label: emails
schema.description: Email strings; first is primary. PII — minimize.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Company name for company.create (required) / company.update.

schema.label: content
schema.description: note.create markdown/plain content. Official Folk `content` (the note text). Required with entityId.

schema.label: customFieldValues
schema.description: Per-group custom values (Folk schema). Required for customField.set.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Pagination cursor for person.search / group.list.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size. Honor provider max.

schema.label: groups
schema.description: [{ "id": "grp_…" }] on create/update. Max 100.

schema.label: phones
schema.description: Request-body parameter `phones` for operations: person.create, person.update, company.create, company.update.

schema.label: jobTitle
schema.description: Request-body parameter `jobTitle` for operations: person.create, person.update.

schema.label: companies
schema.description: Request-body parameter `companies` for operations: person.create, person.update.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Request-body parameter `description` for operations: person.create, person.update, company.create, company.update.

schema.label: combinator
schema.description: Query-string parameter `combinator` for operation: person.search.

schema.label: urls
schema.description: Request-body parameter `urls` for operations: company.create, company.update.

schema.label: addresses
schema.description: Request-body parameter `addresses` for operations: company.create, company.update.

schema.label: industry
schema.description: Request-body parameter `industry` for operations: company.create, company.update.

schema.label: visibility
schema.description: Note visibility on note.create (required there): public = visible to the whole workspace, private = only the API key owner. Also an optional group.list query filter. EXACT: public | private. Example: public.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (people/companies/notes — PII, do not log bodies).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: person.create | person.get | person.update | person.search | company.create | company.get | company.update | group.list | note.create | customField.set | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Folk workspace API key (StudioQuack secret). Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Never log or place on INPUT. Paid-plan API access. Dashboard: https://app.folk.app

configurationParameters.label: API version
configurationParameters.description: Sent as X-API-Version. Official Folk date pin (default 2025-06-09). Invalid date → 400. Paths stay /v1/…

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
